summary: A Hong Kong retiree lost HK$6.6 million after scammers used unsolicited WhatsApp contact to pose as crypto investment and recovery specialists. The victim was persuaded to make repeated transfers across an initial fake investment scheme and two follow on recovery fraud stages before the scammers disappeared.
user_mistake: sent funds to unsolicited investment and recovery contacts
prevention: Block unsolicited investment contacts/Refuse any payment claimed to recover prior losses
